Hired hiring Senior Python Developer (Remote) in United States | LinkedIn

 

# Senior Python Developer (Remote)

 Hired United States 

 10 hours ago 

 Be among the first 25 applicants 

 See who Hired has hired for this role 

## Hired provided pay range 

 This range is provided by Hired. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more. 

### Base pay range

 $30.00/hr - $90.00/hr 

- Role: Senior Python Developer (Remote)
- Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
- Job Type: Contract
- Payout: $30 - $90/hour

Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Python Developer to work on a contract basis. The role involves building and maintaining scalable backend services using Python, with a focus on performance optimization and code quality. Responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy software solutions that meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop, test, and deploy Python-based backend services and APIs with a focus on scalability and efficiency.

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices and design patterns.

• Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and security improvements.

• Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and software quality metrics.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues in production environments, including debugging and root cause analysis.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Proficiency in Python 3.x and experience with frameworks such as Django or Flask.

• Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming principles.

• Experience with RESTful API development and integration with third-party services.

• Familiarity with databases including SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).

• Knowledge of version control systems, preferably Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

• Understanding of cloud platforms, specifically AWS or Azure, for deployment and infrastructure management.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.
